thread:
maria: FYI ran the Riverton LoRA merge (v3b) through the quickpack with int3 quant and seeing SKU linking regressions on the product pages. Not a huge perf hit but correctness dropped.
sam: ugh. can you paste a failing example? quick glance numbers?
maria: example: input -> 'Show latest price for SKU:RVT-9X2'. expected -> link to product page 9X2, got -> generic product search results. repro in eval harness:
```
>>> run_eval --model rwd/v3b+lora-riverton --quant int3 --prompt "Show latest price for SKU:RVT-9X2"
score: pass=0.0, top1_link_accuracy=0.22
```
sam: top1_link_accuracy 22% is bad. on baseline without lora or with fp16 it was ~88% right?
maria: baseline (v3b fp16): top1_link_accuracy=0.89 on same eval pack.
leo: did we change tokenization or special-token handling in the merge? SKU prefix might be getting split differently under int3 codepath.
jun: int3 quant changes shouldn't alter token boundaries, but our post-quant fusion step might be dropping certain sentinel embeddings. i'll run the tokenizer diff.
eva: also check KV cache dtype casts — if embeddings collapse near-zero it can break exact-match heuristics we use for SKU anchors.
ci-bot: CI test "riverton-quickpack-int3" failed — 1 test failing: sku_linkage_check (see build 8842). (added by ci-bot)
maria: attaching quick metrics from the smoke run: pass@1 0.18, exact_match 0.21, avg_latency 76ms (int3), avg_latency 142ms (fp16). so perf improved but correctness tanked.
leo: improvement in latency expected. tradeoff unacceptable for Riverton; customers rely on precise SKU linking. propose: try (A) re-run with per-channel quant params (less aggressive for embedding layers), (B) try int4 fallback for last N layers, (C) run a tiny adapter-retrain to preserve sentinel tokens.
sam: +1 to per-layer softer quant for embedding/special tokens. can we quickly instrument the embedding norms pre/post quant?
jun: running norm diff now. quick snippet i'm using:
```
# compute L2 norms for special token embeddings
python tools/inspect_embeddings.py --model rwd/v3b+lora-riverton.int3 --tokens "[SKU]" "RVT"
```
jun: norm summary: fp16 norm=1.02, int3 norm=0.03 for token "[SKU]" — huge collapse.
eva: that's our smoking gun. if sentinel collapsing, matching heuristics will fail. likely quantization zeroing those dimensions.
maria: action items: jun will try per-channel quant for embedding table and re-run quickpack; leo will test int4-last-layers fallback; sam will prepare a minimal adapter retrain plan (1 epoch on SKU anchor set) and eva will run the heuristics check to see whether small embedding rescale fixes it.
oncall-bot: alert created: #CUST-RIVERTON-REGRESS (sev: low) assigned to eng-ml. (added by oncall-bot)
sam: timeline? we need a patch for customer before next deploy window tomorrow.
jun: per-channel quant experiment queued, should have a smoke snapshot in ~40m. i'll post results here.
maria: thanks team — ping me if you need access to Riverton test data set, i put a curated SKU anchor set in GCS: gs://rwd-riverton/sku-anchor-quickpack.json
sam: ok keeping this thread as the coordination hub. :handshake:
